# Unit III numbers (generated by `python src/pbl2_unit3.py`; do not edit by hand)

4612 vendors projected to km around (12.8761, 80.1147). Seed 42.

## 1 Measuring dissimilarity

Over 19995 random vendor pairs, against the haversine (great-circle) distance:

| distance used | mean rel. error | max rel. error |
|---|---|---|
| Euclidean on projected km (x = Δlon·111.32·cos φ0, y = Δlat·111.32) | 0.00114 | 0.00186 |
| Euclidean on raw degrees (×111.32) | 0.01156 | 0.02770 |

- K-means (K = 8) on raw degrees vs on km: ARI 0.9947; about 13 vendors change cluster. A degree of longitude is shorter than a degree of latitude here, so raw degrees stretch east-west distances.

- Minimum over K = 1..25: BIC → 25, AIC → 25, held-out likelihood → 23, silhouette (max) → 2. BIC still falling at the edge of the range: True.
- **K used = 5** (knee of the BIC curve: farthest point below the chord from K = 1 to the largest K).
- Own vs scikit-learn at K = 5: k-means J 88379.42 vs 88386.61; GMM ln p -27215.33 vs -27215.33.

## 4 Alternative view of EM (K = 5)

- 72 iterations; ln p(X) -29458.59 → -27215.33, never decreasing: True.
- KL gap after each M-step (closed by the next E-step): first five 117, 112, 115, 212, 143; minimum 1.18e-04 (≥ 0 always).

## 5 K-means as the limit of EM; hard vs soft

| shared variance ε (km²) | ARI vs k-means | mean max responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| 10.0 | 0.9782 | 0.9439 |
| 1.0 | 0.9963 | 0.9951 |
| 0.1 | 0.9973 | 0.9997 |
| 0.01 | 0.9994 | 1.0000 |

- K-means vs full GMM partitions: ARI 0.5420. 1138 vendors have max responsibility < 0.9 and 220 have < 0.6 (border vendors k-means forces into one zone).

## 7 PCA and factor analysis: retail mix of grid cells

- Own eigendecomposition vs scikit-learn: max |Δ eigenvalue| 5.77e-15.
- First 5 components explain 0.1239, 0.0959, 0.0865, 0.0735, 0.0659 (cumulative 0.4458).

## 8 Hierarchical clustering of the 23 categories

Cophenetic correlation (how well the tree preserves the original distances):

| dissimilarity | single | complete | average | ward |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| correlation_of_cell_shares | 0.5410 | 0.6369 | 0.6584 | 0.5837 |
| jaccard_of_vendor_sets | 0.7649 | 0.8345 | 0.8821 | 0.3990 |

Five groups from the average-linkage tree on spatial correlation:

- group 1: meat_fish, ration_pds
- group 2: hardware, pharmacy
- group 3: auto_parts, electronics, home_appliances, kirana_provisions, optical, pet_supplies
- group 4: apparel_footwear, beauty_personal_care, household_homeware, mobile_accessories
- group 5: bakery_sweets, dairy_eggs, florists, food_stalls, fruits, grocery_supermarket, stationery_books, street_markets, vegetables

## 9 Does a GMM zone feature help the Phase 1 match-score model?

Same split by requirement as Phase 1 (24 train / 6 test requirements).

| model | train R² | test R² | test RMSE | coef of new feature |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| phase1_features | 0.7983 | 0.7510 | 17.458 | – |
| + same_zone (hard GMM) | 0.8002 | 0.7632 | 17.024 | 4.828 |
| + zone_overlap (soft GMM) | 0.7999 | 0.7543 | 17.340 | 5.388 |

- 0.5667 of pairs have buyer and vendor in the same zone; correlation with within_radius 0.7276.
